Alex M: Auditor Jones asked for a compact evidence bundle: KMS rotation events (last 12 months), RBAC snapshots for prod+staging around the Nov incident (INC-2025-11-02), and the incident playbook execution logs. Who can assemble a minimal, auditable bundle?
Auditor Jones: Thanks. Prefer CSVs for log events and a clear mapping to SOC2/ISO controls. Need keyId, eventTime, userIdentity, eventName and checksum of the bundle. Also want chain-of-custody info (who pulled what and when).
Priya S: We can export CloudTrail entries filtered for kms events. We'll include RotateKey/CreateKey schedules. Export path will be s3://redwood-audit/exports/1789456789/. Example CLI I plan to run:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time '2024-11-01T00:00:00Z' --end-time '2025-11-03T00:00:00Z' --output json > kms-events-2024-2025.json
```
That yields userIdentity, eventTime, requestParameters.keyId etc. I can convert to CSV with jq.
Dave O: For RBAC snapshot I'll capture rolebindings + clusterrolebindings and a user-to-group mapping. Commands:
```
kubectl get rolebindings --all-namespaces -o yaml > rbac-rolebindings-prod-20251102.yaml
kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o yaml > rbac-clusterrolebindings-prod-20251102.yaml
```
I'll also export the AD/Okta group membership dump (CSV).
Jamie R: Playbook runner keeps logs in two places: /var/log/playbook-runner/* and our internal audit table incident_runs. I can export SQL rows for INC-2025-11-02:
```
-- psql export
COPY (SELECT id, incident_id, started_at, actions, actor, json_summary FROM incident_runs WHERE incident_id = 'INC-2025-11-02') TO '/tmp/incident-20251102.csv' CSV HEADER;
```
Collecting action-level timestamps is important for timeline reconstruction.
Auditor Jones: Can you include checksums for every file (sha256) and a small manifest mapping control IDs to filenames? Example mapping expected: CC6.4 -> kms rotation, CC4.1 -> rbac snapshot, CC7.2 -> incident playbook logs.
Priya S: Will create a manifest.txt and manifest-checksums.txt. Proposed filenames: kms-rotate-2024-2025.csv, rbac-prod-20251102.yaml, rbac-staging-20251102.yaml, incident-20251102.csv, custody.txt. I'll add a brief note in custody.txt with UTC times and usernames who performed exports.
CollectorBot: Started export job. Creating archive at s3://redwood-audit/exports/1789456789/bundle-inprogress.tar.gz
Alex M: Also need to show proof that KMS key rotations happened (CloudTrail eventName RotateKey or UpdateKeyDescription + key state changes). Priya, include key metadata snapshot (keyId, alias, rotationEnabled boolean) as key-metadata.csv.
Priya S: Will do. Plan: generate kms-rotate-2024-2025.csv with columns: keyId,eventTime,eventName,userIdentity,requestParameters,region. Then key-metadata.csv from aws kms list-keys + describe-key loop.
Dave O: I will timestamp and sign the RBAC YAMLs with my GPG key and include signature files (.sig) — helps chain-of-custody.
Priya S: Mapping to controls in manifest (quick list):
- SOC2 CC6.4: kms-rotate-2024-2025.csv
- SOC2 CC4.1: rbac-prod-20251102.yaml, rbac-staging-20251102.yaml
- SOC2 CC7.2: incident-20251102.csv + playbook logs tarball
- ISO 27001 A.12.4: cloudtrail-config.txt (trail ARN + S3 bucket)
Auditor Jones: Good. One last ask: can you provide a short note on log retention policy and when exports were taken relative to retention windows? We need assurance logs haven't been pruned.
Jamie R: Retention: CloudTrail events kept 2 years in S3, with Glacier transition at 180 days. The incident_runs table retains 5 years, backups monthly. I'll include a small retention-statement.txt in the bundle.
Alex M: @Priya S @Dave O please confirm when exports finish so I can package and compute final checksums. I'll upload the final bundle and post here with S3 path + sha256.
Priya S: Export complete 2025-11-03T14:12:00Z — kms-rotate-2024-2025.csv and key-metadata.csv uploaded. sha256: 8f3a1b... :white_check_mark:
Dave O: RBAC snapshots and .sig files uploaded 2025-11-03T14:20:05Z to s3://redwood-audit/exports/1789456789/rbac/ sha256 for bundle-part: d3b2f4... :white_check_mark:
CollectorBot: Final archive created s3://redwood-audit/exports/1789456789/redwood-audit-bundle-1789456789.tar.gz sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... (manifest included)
Auditor Jones: Received bundle link and manifest. I'll review and follow up with any control trace questions tomorrow. Thanks all.
Alex M: Thanks team — will file a short handoff ticket with the bundle link for records.
